name: gsplat examples (simple_trainer)

parts.gsplat library: not vendored: pip gsplat==1.5.3 (the same release), installed by methods/bilagrid/setup_kaggle.sh; its CUDA code is compiled on first use

changes: only the files simple_trainer.py needs to train and render: simple_trainer.py, utils.py, lib_bilagrid.py, gsplat_viewer.py (imported at module level), requirements.txt, datasets/colmap.py, datasets/normalize.py, datasets/traj.py, and LICENSE; copied from the v1.5.3 tag (codeload tarball) unchanged
runtime_patches: applied by methods/bilagrid/adapter.py on a COPY in the run's work dir: datasets/colmap.py trains on every image (upstream held out every test_every-th, always image 0); datasets/__init__.py added (empty) so the Hugging Face 'datasets' package installed on Kaggle cannot shadow this namespace package. simple_trainer.py also saves the bilateral grids (bil_grids) in its checkpoints. See methods/bilagrid/README.md
